contents.name: Assumption 11.2: C1 forward map, solution ball, derivative scaling, and uniform two-point TCC
Assumption 11.2: hypotheses for the Fejer and discrepancy theorem
Lemma 11.3 and complete proof: one-step squared-error decrease above the discrepancy threshold
Theorem 11.4 and complete proof: finite first stopping index, O(delta^-2) bound, and exact-data residual-square summability
Theorem 11.5 and complete proof: exact-data strong convergence using a minimum-residual index on each finite block
Theorem 11.6 and complete proof: fixed-index stability and noisy-data discrepancy convergence
Remark after Theorem 11.6: rates require an additional source condition and technical nonlinear assumptions
contents.reason: The assigned theorem states exact/noisy convergence only; it claims no rate or source-condition implication.
